description: This file defines a generic class StorageDataSetGeneric<TGrainKey, TStateData> that generates test data for storage tests in an Orleans-based project. It provides sample grain state objects with randomized data for different test cases.

classes.name: StorageDataSetGeneric
classes.description: A generic test data generator class for Orleans grain storage testing, providing different data sets based on test case number.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple with grain type string, grain ID, and grain state with randomized data based on the test case number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Provides enumeration over test case indices for generating multiple data sets.
